ideas.pitch: An Arduino-based multi-sensor telemetry rig designed to monitor temperature stability and magnetic field fluctuations in sub-kelvin quantum hardware environments.
ideas.title: Quantum Cryo-Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the quantum hardware and sensor integration theme directly with a tangible physical build that works live on a breadboard.

ideas.pitch: A microcontroller-driven pulse generation and visualization tool for testing rudimentary superconducting qubit control lines.
ideas.title: Superconducting Pulse Generator UI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hands-on engineering capability with circuits and microcontrollers, matching the evaluation style of practical hardware rounds.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-software bridge that translates acoustic or electrical resonator signals into real-time state analysis plots using lightweight edge processing.
ideas.title: Acoustic Qubit Readout Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines signal analysis with physical testing, directly fitting the analysis and hardware problem-solving focus of the event.

ideas.pitch: A compact FPGA-based hardware block implementing basic quantum logic gate operations for rapid prototyping of quantum control architecture.
ideas.title: Modular FPGA Quantum Gate Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages genuine hard engineering in digital logic and FPGA design, standing out in a hardware-centric competition.

ideas.pitch: An automated safety and stabilization interlock circuit using microcontrollers to protect sensitive photonic or optical quantum components from drift.
ideas.title: Optomechanical Sensor Interlock
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a working physical prototype with real sensors and actuators that can be demonstrated live to judges.
